criteria.ame_must_review: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the Hepatologist or treating physician verifies:
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] Condition is under control, insulin resistance (if present) is adequately treated, and no symptoms (such as fatigue or malaise) that would interfere with flight or safety related duties.

criteria.ame_must_review: Any clinical evidence or diagnosis of cirrhosis:
Fibrosis score from lab or imaging performed no more than 90 day ago None of the values are exceeded:
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] FIB-4 index* is less than 2.68; or [ ] Ultrasound-based vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE) is less than 8 kPa; or [ ] Magnetic resonance elastography is less than 2.55 kPa *If an imaging study has not been performed, calculate the FIB-4 index (requires age, platelet count, AST, and ALT).
[ ] None [ ] Vitamin E [ ] Weight loss medication (see that page)
